title: Verify Skill results on direct production execution path
goal: Ensure the public M8 executeSkill API never returns executor output as success unless the configured Skill executor verifies it.
context: SkillAgentOrchestrator already verifies after execution, but M8CompositionRoot.executeSkill previously returned SkillRuntime.execute output directly. Callers of this public direct API could receive unverified output as a successful result.
forbidden_changes: Do not bypass or weaken policy and approval checks.
Do not treat missing executors as success.
Do not alter Agent scope selection or executor registration semantics.
Do not modify App/ or Xcode project files.
acceptance_criteria: SkillRuntime exposes a direct execution method that only returns output after executor verification.
M8CompositionRoot.executeSkill uses the verified execution path.
A regression test proves executor output rejected by its verifier throws instead of returning success.
verification: Confirm Swift package tests + repository integrity, Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA, and validate-contract CI gates.
recovery: Revert this single logical task if verified execution changes existing runtime contracts or fails the full required gates.
